name: branding-four-colour-tiger-milk-mark-window-banners
title: Four-Colour Maze Monogram Banners
whatItIs: Four tall street banners in navy, dark green, plum and orange, each carrying the same blocky maze-like monogram in a contrasting colour (mint, yellow, pink, cream) with 'Opening soon' text and a handle, with a passer-by looking on.
whatItMeans: One simple mark recoloured across vivid grounds shows a flexible, playful identity that still reads as one brand.
techniques: Same mark in four colour pairings
Bilingual small text at the base
Person in the scene for scale
Consistent mark size and position on every banner

vocabulary.definition: Recolouring one logo across multiple palette pairs.
A pre-opening banner showing the mark and a date cue.
A logo built from blocky geometric strokes.
